name: RFL_PAYER_NOTIF_ADMSN
description: This table contains information about notifications of admissions associated with an encounter.

columns.name: REFERRAL_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the referral record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: NOTF_MSG_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The type of admission notification sent to the payer organization.

columns.name: NOTIF_MSG_SENT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The sent instant (in UTC) for the specified payer notification message.

columns.name: NOTIF_MSG_REC_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant (in UTC) for the notification response received from the payer notification message that was previously sent.

columns.name: NOTF_MSG_STATU_C_NAME
columns.description: The status for the payer notification message, including Sent, Processed, Error, Manually Resolved, etc.

columns.name: NOTIF_REF_NUM
columns.description: The reference number associated to the payer notification message.
